_note: Question sets of the three RAG demonstration sessions in the paper (Section 6.2), taken verbatim from the original session artifacts (5 April 2026). Sessions 2 and 3 use the same 10 questions. The original session 3 also logged an 11th turn whose query was the single character 'y' (feedback typed at the question prompt); it is not a question and is omitted here.
